answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 27724 Country: India Title: If a husband imagines that he is giving talaq 3 times to his wife, does that talaq occurs (valid)? Question: **URGENT please** Assalaamualikum, dear ulema ekram, if a husband imagines that he is giving talaq 3 times to his wife, does that talaq occurs (valid)? Answer ID: 27724 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1674/1674/M=1431) Talaq does not take place merely by imagination until one does not pronounce it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
